original_unique_solution: The two end triangles are BGJ and CFI. Rectangle ABJH gives BJ=AH=8. Rectangle FIDE gives its axial side ID=EF=8; all three lateral rectangles have this same axial length, so HJ=AB=BC=EF=8. G,J,H occur in that order along the same original straight boundary. Therefore GJ=GH-HJ=14-8=6. The original square at J gives BJ perpendicular JG. Volume=(8*6/2)*8=192. This uses rectangular faces and prism incidence, never screen lengths.
